key_findings: **INTERPRETATION CORRECTED**: the 4 vftables at 0x00FDF968..0x00FDF98C are NOT StatusBase's additional MI sub-vftables. Each vftable has its OWN COL pointing to its OWN CHD with its OWN numBaseClasses count (2 or 3), NOT StatusBase's CHD (numBaseClasses=11). These are 4 STANDALONE classes living adjacent in .data after StatusBase's secondary vftable boundary at 0x00FDF964.

**StatusBase's actual MI structure**: per BCA at 0x0115F858, 11 BCDs distributed across 4 subobject positions (offsets 0/+4/+96/+100). 4 vftable positions, NOT 6 as the claimed. None of StatusBase's 11 BCDs reference the 3 interface TDs (0x012C32A0/0x012C3308/0x01270A90) or the vftable A TD (0x012C3238). StatusBase does NOT inherit from any of these 4 classes.

**MAJOR NEW DISCOVERY - Application::Lua::LuaAppBase** (TD 0x0126CFAC, CHD 0x011447DC): the ROOT ABSTRACT BASE of the Lua-bridge interface hierarchy. No own vftable - pure interface class with no runtime polymorphic dispatch table. 5 BCDs across the binary reference LuaAppBase TD at distinct MI positions (offsets 0/4/8/12), indicating LuaAppBase has many derivatives in different inheritance configurations.

**4 LuaAppBase-derived standalone classes** identified in the 0x00FDF968..0x00FDF98C region (all leaf abstract interfaces with no further derivatives per xref scan): (1) DisplayNameResolverListener (BCS-Y-1585) at vftable 0x00FDF968 - listener for actor display-name resolution events; (2) SpreadSheetLoadedDataDisappearListenerInterface (BCS-Y-1583) at vftable 0x00FDF974 - spreadsheet data lifecycle listener; (3) Command::CommandInterface (BCS-Y-1584) at vftable 0x00FDF980 - command-namespace abstract interface (DISTINCT from the CommandInterface referenced by AchievementXxx receivers); (4) LuaActorImplInterface at vftable 0x00FDF98C - already cataloged at BCS-Y-1049, 90-slot abstract contract with 89 pure-virtuals.

**LuaActorImplInterface has 90 slots, NOT 13** (dump-truncation artifact corrected). Slot 0 = FUN_00776930 (dtor/vftable writer), slots 1-89 = __purecall. Concrete derivatives (LuaActorImpl BCS-Y-1048 at 0x00FDFB2C, NullActorImpl at 0x00FE02AC) must implement 89 methods.

**2 incidental InterfaceToSqwt classes** decoded while resolving LuaAppBase: Application::Lua::InterfaceToSqwt::SendStoryboardCommandProcessorInterface (BCS-Y-1586) at TD 0x0126CFD8 and Application::Lua::InterfaceToSqwt::SetPropertyProcessorInterface (BCS-Y-1587) at TD 0x0126CF60. Both inherit from LuaAppBase. Together they form the Lua->Sqwt UI command dispatch surface (bridging the discovered Sqwt::UIElement cluster).

**4 additional 2-slot vftables** at 0x00FDFAF8/0x00FDFB04/0x00FDFB10/0x00FDFB1C (between LuaActorImplInterface primary at 0x00FDF98C and LuaActorImpl primary at 0x00FDFB2C) - these are likely LuaActorImpl's MI sub-vftables (LuaActorImpl is the concrete derivative; its MI bases may include adjacent listener interfaces). Deferred for full enumeration.

**MSVC RTTI COL pClassDescriptor as ownership disambiguator**: for a vftable whose Ghidra label is 'BaseClass::vftable', the COL's pClassDescriptor field disambiguates ownership: if it points to BaseClass's own CHD, the vftable is BaseClass's primary; if it points to a Derived class's CHD, it's Derived class's MI sub-vftable for BaseClass. This disambiguator to overturn the interpretation.
